propositions: The Makefile typecheck target runs mypy only over src/rebar and does not include the 47 Python files under scripts/, despite scripts being linted by ruff
CI gate scripts (e.g. scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py) that enforce the Verified vote are themselves outside the type-check scope, allowing latent type errors in gate logic

15 mypy errors exist across 6 files in scripts/ (check_raw_git_writes.py, plan_review_impact_distribution.py, capture_jira_fixtures.py, probe_rebar.py, check_complexity_baseline.py, t5c_calibrate.py), including two latent bugs: capture_jira_fixtures calling .strip() on str|None and check_complexity_baseline passing possibly-None dict to a function expecting dict[str,int]
The typecheck target must be widened to mypy src/rebar scripts and all 15 type errors must be fixed at source without new per-module overrides or # type: ignore comments
Documentation in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml incorrectly describes the type-gate scope as full src/rebar only, not matching the widened Makefile recipe
